# Big World of Little Dude

> Big World of Little Dude is a children's book series for ages 3–8, created by Cara Zelas — a Montessori-trained early childhood educator and children's book author. The books use a lovable character named Little Dude to help young children navigate big feelings, friendship, kindness, and everyday social situations. The series is used by parents, teachers, and therapists worldwide.

## Pages

- [Home](https://worldoflittledude.com/): Overview of the Big World of Little Dude book series and resources
- [Shop](https://worldoflittledude.com/shop.html): Books, plush toys, and activity packs for children ages 3–8
- [About](https://worldoflittledude.com/about.html): About Cara Zelas — author, educator, and creator of Big World of Little Dude
- [Blog](https://worldoflittledude.com/blog.html): Parenting and early childhood articles on social skills, big feelings, and child development
- [Media](https://worldoflittledude.com/media.html): Press coverage, media appearances, and speaking engagements
- [Contact](https://worldoflittledude.com/contact.html): Contact Cara Zelas for media, partnerships, and school inquiries

## Shop

- Books, plush toys, and activity packs available at [shop.worldoflittledude.com](https://shop.worldoflittledude.com)

## About the Creator

Cara Zelas is a Montessori-trained early childhood educator, children's book author, and the founder of Big World of Little Dude. She is also the creator of humanKIND Classroom, a social skills program for Pre-K through Grade 2 teachers at humankindclassroom.com.
